facts.text: The resort sits on the tip of a barrier island in northeastern Florida.
facts.excerpt: On the tip of a barrier island in northeastern Florida

facts.text: The resort overlooks the white sands of Fernandina Beach and the Atlantic Ocean.
facts.excerpt: a serene location overlooking the white sands of Fernandina Beach and the Atlantic Ocean

facts.text: The pool deck includes an adults-only pool, a family pool and a splash pad.
facts.excerpt: including an adults-only pool, family pool and splash pad

facts.text: Guest rooms and suites have furnished balconies with ocean views.
facts.excerpt: modern and bright with furnished balconies to enjoy uninterrupted ocean views

facts.text: Oceanfront rooms are in the Sunrise wing, with access to FloraBelle and the Sunrise beach boardwalk.
facts.excerpt: Located in the Sunrise wing, these guest rooms feature breathtaking views of the Atlantic Ocean and offer convenient access to FloraBelle and the Sunrise beach boardwalk.

facts.text: The resort has 36 holes of championship golf plus a 10-hole short course.
facts.excerpt: 36 holes of championship golf plus a 10-hole short course

facts.text: The 10-hole short course Little Sandy was named Best Short Course of 2022 by Sports Illustrated.
facts.excerpt: the 10-hole short course, Little Sandy, named "Best Short Course of 2022" by Sports Illustrated

facts.text: The Oak Marsh golf course was recently renovated and named Best Private Resort Course Renovation of 2025 by Sports Illustrated.
facts.excerpt: the recently renovated Oak Marsh golf course, named the "Best Private Resort Course Renovation of 2025" by Sports Illustrated

facts.text: The spa is nature-inspired, with a courtyard featuring water features.
facts.excerpt: our reimagined, nature-inspired spa, featuring a serene new courtyard with tranquil water features

facts.text: The spa's signature Quartz Sand Table massage has the guest lie on warm sand.
facts.excerpt: try the signature Quartz Sand Table massage where guest lays on warm sand

facts.text: The resort has 23 Har-Tru tennis courts and 7 pickleball courts.
facts.excerpt: 23 Har-Tru® tennis courts and 7 pickleball courts

facts.text: The fitness center has Peloton bikes and an indoor lap pool.
facts.excerpt: A fully-equipped fitness center with Peloton bikes and an indoor lap pool

facts.text: Guests have access to 3.5 miles of uncrowded beaches.
facts.excerpt: Access to 3.5 miles of uncrowded beaches

facts.text: The resort has over 7 miles of walking, jogging and biking trails.
facts.excerpt: Over 7 miles of walking, jogging and biking trails

facts.text: Kayaking, paddleboarding, fishing and adventure tours are offered.
facts.excerpt: Kayaking, paddleboarding, fishing and adventure tours

facts.text: Preserved marshlands for kayaking and paddle-boarding are at the resort's doorstep.
facts.excerpt: access to preserved marshlands for kayaking and paddle-boarding at your doorstep

facts.text: The grounds have Spanish moss-adorned live oaks.
facts.excerpt: beautifully untamed grounds rich with Spanish moss-adorned live oaks

facts.text: Omni Hotels & Resorts acquired the former Amelia Inn in 2010.
facts.excerpt: In 2010 Omni Hotels & Resorts acquired the former Amelia Inn

facts.text: Every room has an ocean view.
facts.excerpt: Every room at the Omni Amelia Island has an ocean view

facts.text: The Sprouting Project is the resort's sustainable greenhouse and garden operation, which has beehives.
facts.excerpt: the Sprouting Project, the resort’s sustainable greenhouse and garden operation—perhaps a cocktail with honeycomb sourced from its beehives

facts.text: The nature center offers a chance to see turtles, snakes and Buddy the Macaw.
facts.excerpt: The nature center will become a daily visit for any animal-lovers with a chance to see and maybe interact with turtles, snakes, and Buddy the Macaw.

facts.excerpt: a discovery series designed for kids to find shark teeth, learn about sea turtles, or go fishing and crabbing

facts.text: Camp Amelia offers daytime or evening sessions for kids.
facts.excerpt: Look to Camp Amelia for daytime or evening sessions

facts.text: The resort is about 29 miles, about 45 minutes, from Jacksonville International Airport.
facts.excerpt: About 29 miles (about 45 minutes) from Jacksonville International Airport (JAX)
